definitions: A Roman consul and general, known for his integrity and simple lifestyle.
Manlius Curius Dentatus was a plebeian novus homo, meaning he was the first in his family to achieve senatorial rank.
examples: Curius Dentatus famously rejected Samnite bribes.
The victories of Curius Dentatus were celebrated in Rome.
Curius Dentatus was a paragon of Roman virtue.
